title: The Same File in PowerShell
description: The Windows version of the global config: create the directory with New-Item and write opencode.json from a here-string.

steps.description: This is the Windows, PowerShell version of the same two steps. It writes the same global `opencode.json` under your user profile.
`New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force` creates the `.config\opencode` directory. `-Force` tolerates an existing directory, and `| Out-Null` suppresses its output.
`Set-Content` writes the file with UTF-8 encoding, taking the value from the here-string that starts at `@'`.
The body holds the same `$schema` key, and `'@` closes the here-string.

steps.question: The page says the $schema line tells an editor what, so a typo in permission or provider is underlined while you type?
